text:
Sam: starting a quick check-in — planning a small blue->green lift for router pool 'orbit-edge' tonight during the 01:00-02:00 UTC change window. will increment traffic in micro-steps.
Priya: +1. what's the initial weight and step size?
Sam: initial 5%, then +5% every 3 mins for 30 mins, hold checks at 15m and 30m. rollback threshold: p95 latency or error rate > 2x baseline for 2 consecutive windows.
Jordan: tagging load tests: ran a short ramp earlier, baseline p95 ~ 210ms, error ~0.03%. keep an eye on 5xxs.
Mika: will pin session affinity to green for 5m after drain to avoid split sessions. config snippet I plan to apply: ```
route: orbit-edge
strategy:
  type: weighted
  steps: [5,10,15,25,40,60,80,100]
affinity: "cookie:5m"
```
Priya: sounds good. confirm deploy-bot flow?
deploy-bot: Received rollout request: project=router, pool=orbit-edge, version=router-v3.2.1, policy=staged-weighted, window=01:00-02:00 UTC. kickoff in 30m unless aborted. (ops-ticket #RELEASE-348)
Sam: I'll trigger manual kickoff at :01:00, want an explicit green-check before step beyond 25%.
OpsLead: We'll watch infra metrics and SLOs. Ops on-call (Carol) will call rollback if anomalous spike.
Carol: I'll be on pager and in this thread. if we hit >0.6% 5xx or p95 >450ms, call immediate drain.
Jordan: adding canary traffic health probe (rerank + openapi endpoints) to smoke checks. failing probe = stop and hold.
Priya: note: we need to update release notes and console rollout label: "orbit-edge v3.2.1 - micro-lift" before kickoff. I'll post them.
Sam: preflight checklist
- changelog baked and linked
- infra hooks set
- poison-pill thresholds configured
- rollback runbook ready
- canary probes added
Sam: starting rollout now (kickoff 01:00:30 UTC) — step 1 -> 5%
deploy-bot: Step 1 complete: 5% -> green. metrics: p95=212ms, errors=0.04% :white_check_mark:
Mika: session-affinity cookie set on green nodes.
Sam: ramp to 10% -> holding 3m
deploy-bot: Step 2 complete: 10% -> green. metrics stable.
Jordan: small spike on one region (eu-west). investigating 502s from edge-proxy-12.
Carol: I'm seeing increased connection resets; pinning eu-west to green only to avoid cross-region flapping.
Sam: pause ramping at 10%. Diagnostic commands: ``kubectl logs edge-proxy-12 -n orbit | tail -n 200`` — Jordan, can you paste error trace?
Jordan: pasted short trace: "upstream connect error: no healthy upstream" — origin was a sidecar health probe failing during warmup. it's isolated.
Mika: bumped warmup to 60s for proxy sidecars. will redeploy green nodes with updated readiness.
Priya: because of the pause, extend window to 02:15 UTC. OpsLead ok?
OpsLead: OK to extend 15m. keep step size unchanged.
deploy-bot: Holding rollout at 10% pending readiness.
Sam: once green readiness is fixed, we'll resume and skip to 25% (two-step jump) to reduce total window. confirm rollback thresholds still same.
Carol: confirmed. if eu-west 5xx >0.5% in next 10m, we'll start rollback to blue and drain green.
Jordan: fix rolled and redeployed. re-running canary probes now.
deploy-bot: Canary probe passed. ready to resume. next step -> 25%
Sam: resuming. Step jump to 25% -> monitoring closely.
deploy-bot: Step complete: 25% -> green. metrics: p95=225ms, errors=0.05%
Priya: I've updated release notes + console rollout label. link: https://console.redwood/inference/releases/RELEASE-348
Sam: proceeding steady. final checklist: post-rollout smoke, update pinned version in traffic-control, and verify logs for error regressions.
OpsLead: thumbs up. will handover to SRE after 02:15 UTC watch window.
Mika: once we hit 100% we'll run a quick KV cache warm sweep to avoid cold-start token bursts.
Sam: successful cutoff planned ~02:05 UTC if no regressions. thanks all :rocket:
